shadow-appeal.name: Shadow Appeal
shadow-appeal.description: Insights gained through the Caul reduce the difficulty of shadow-directed social manipulation by two, including beyond the usual modifier limit.

qi-manipulation.name: Qì Manipulation
qi-manipulation.summary: Sense and redirect the flow of qì through bodies and places, restoring balance or deliberately creating blockages.

palimpsest.summary: Restores faded or altered documents and art to an earlier state.
